## Requirements (§7.2 — R-2.11.2¹, C1/Stage-4 slice)

1. Views: V1 run browser, V2 trace viewer, V3-scrub (time-travel scrub only),
   V5-monitor (experiment monitor — no launcher), V6 scorecard/comparison,
   V7 leaderboard, V8 approval inbox, V9 audit views, V10 registry browser,
   V11-run bundle/repro view — over binding (c).
2. Binding (c): JSON-RPC over localhost HTTP — kernel-side strict profile
   (browser origins rejected outright) + WS-H3/K2 authentication scheme
   (owned decision → ADR).
3. Full security battery P1–P13 / AC-K2-6 — NOT deferrable.
4. Pure projection: no state of record; every view is project/render with its
   watermark; no far-side recomputation.
5. Sink: `measurement.export.delivered{sink: surface(session_ref), …}` for
   content-class deliveries (surface's own reads appear in
   `audit_view.sink_deliveries`); `lifecycle.session.attached/detached{binding:
   local_network, client{kind: web}}`.
6. Ephemeral discipline: stream_events frames live, never persisted;
   reconnect = replay-from-cursor + dedupe by seq.
7. R-D-1…8 dashboard rendering invariants (n/a reasons, indistinguishable
   sets, badges, report_id/view_hash headers, deep links).
8. removability(0…3) unchanged; CC1–CC10 hold.

## Acceptance criteria

AC-R-2.11.2-{1–8,10,12–15} + removability(0…3) + universal phase-gate ACs.

## Plan

Architecture (owned decisions → ADR-0301/0302):

1. **`hh-wire::http`** (new) — the ONE HTTP/1.1 request/response codec
   (CC1): head parse, content-length body, response write/read. Shared by
   the binding-(c) server, the generated client's NetClient and `hh-web`.
2. **Binding (c)** — `hh_embed::net`: `serve_net(listener, svc, auth)` —
   JSON-RPC over localhost HTTP: `POST /hh-embed/1` = one canonical
   request → canonical response (byte-identical envelopes: the same
   `EmbedService::handle`); `GET /hh-embed/1/events[?wait_ms=]` =
   notification drain as NDJSON. Strict profile: `Authorization: Bearer`
   (per-launch ≥128-bit token, constant-time), `Origin` present → 403
   (browser origins rejected outright), `Host` == bound authority → 400,
   `?token=` → refused, loopback-only bind (OQ-401: wider exposure is a
   fourth binding). WS-H3/K2 auth = per-launch bearer minted by the
   kernel serve, delivered via `--token-file` (mode 600) / `--token` /
   one stderr line (ADR'd; OQ-389 interim delivery).
3. **Schema (`hh-embed-schema`)** — additive members (CC8):
   `OpenSessionParams.client{kind, sink?}`; `RespondPermissionParams.
   responder{subject_ref, surface_session_ref}`; new op `run_index`
   (Group R, session-free — the store-level index V1 needs; precedent:
   `lab.results.*` session-free reads). Regen via `hh-codegen`.
4. **`hh-ledger`** — `Store::run_index(filter, cursor, limit)`: per-run
   manifest + tail-event fold (O(#runs·1) + result-bound page; status =
   finished|open; outcome from `lifecycle.run.finished`).
   `security.permission.decided` partition += `responder_provenance`,
   `request_id`.
5. **`hh-embed`** — dep `hh-telemetry`; `project` gains `trace_view`,
   `cost_view`, `effect_ledger`, `branch_tree` kinds (owner-projection
   folds; the ledger refuses OwnerProjected kinds with a typed error
   before — the boundary now performs the owning fold per ADR-0042 D2);
   `run_index` dispatch; `open_session{client}` →
   `lifecycle.session.attached/detached{binding: local_network,
   client{kind}}` via `commit_kernel_row_for` (attach sessions have no
   lease); `binding_label` on the service ("local_network" set by the
   (c) server); `measurement.export.delivered{sink_id:
   surface:<session>, view_kind, seq_range, content_classes}` minted on
   content-class servings (read/project-content/get_artifact/durable
   stream frames) to `client.kind == "web"` sessions.
6. **`hh-embed-client-generated` lib.rs** — `NetClient`: POST + GET
   drain over `hh_wire::http` with the bearer; same hello contract
   checks as `Client`.
7. **`hh-kernel`** — `serve --http <addr> [--token-file|--token]`.
8. **`hh-web`** (new crate + `hh-web` bin) — the surface process:
   `gate` (P1–P13: Host, token (constant-time), Origin allow-list,
   Sec-Fetch-Site refusal, mutating-route fetch-metadata + script-only
   header, query-token refusal, off-loopback bind refusal, hardening
   headers), `server` (GET / shell, /app.js /app.css, POST /api
   forwarding + session injection, GET /events NDJSON relay), `session`
   (per-run attach sessions `client{kind:web}` + writer sessions for
   respond/amend), `views` (ViewModel shaping per V1–V11 — pure
   selection/labeling, never recompute; R-D-1…8 enforced),
   `sink` (declared SinkPolicy + response withholding when a class is
   out of policy), `ui` (static HTML/JS — presentation only).
9. **Op allow-list (C1)** — reads: hello, open_session, close,
   stream_events, read, head, project, account, describe, lineage,
   get_artifact, audit_view, verify, prove_inclusion, prove_consistency,
   run_index, coherent_fork_points (experimental — honest typed refusal
   path), lab.results.*, lab.leaderboard.{leaderboard,diff_snapshots,
   snapshots}, lab.analysis.{render,diff_reports}, lab.registry.* reads,
   kernel.{bundle,validate,check_completeness,status,lineage,diff,
   audit_bundle}; writes (fetch-metadata + script-header): respond_
   permission, amend{budget}, kernel.reproduce. Everything else →
   `Refused{op_not_admitted}` at the surface gate — the browser can
   never reach submit/fork/rollback/apply/register/publish at C1.

## Gap table

| gap | resolution |
|---|---|
| `EmbedService` is not `Send`/`Sync` — a thread-per-connection server can't move it | `serve_net` is serial; `serve_net_n(.., n)` bounded variant drives the tests (client on a spawned thread, service on the caller's) — ADR-0301 D9 |
| `run_index` had to be session-free but every Group-R read was session-scoped | New `OpSpec` row with the `lab.results.*` precedent — ADR-0301 D5 |
| `open_session` requires the `hello` handshake — the surface's first call returned `NotInitialized` | `Sessions::ensure_hello` greets lazily once (`kind: "web"` — ADR-0302 D3); the stub-kernel tests count the handshake in kernel-seen ops |
| `edit` tool silently failed on `hh-embed-schema/src/ops.rs` (two consecutive writes reported success, file unchanged) | applied via `python3` write — verified by `grep` + the runtime probe (`ops::lookup("run_index")` now resolves) |
| `hh-web` e2e initially hit `unknown_method` — the `run_index` op registration was missing from the built registry (a previous-session edit was lost the same way) | re-applied and verified at runtime; codegen re-run so `hh-embed-1.schema.json` + `generated.rs` carry the op |
| `ClientDecl::from_json` strict-decoded only `{kind, sink}` — the surface's declared `surface_ref`/`ui_caps` members would have made *every* surface `open_session` fail `UnknownField{open_session/client/surface_ref}` against the real kernel | `ClientDecl` extended with optional `surface_ref`/`ui_caps` (additive, CC8); schema re-registered + codegen re-run; `net_open_attach_with_full_web_client_decl` drives the exact member set against a real `EmbedService` over binding (c) and asserts the durable `lifecycle.session.attached` row |
| `views.rs` passed `project{view}` — the schema member is `view_kind`; every `project` call would have refused `SchemaViolation{project/view_kind}` on the real kernel | all seven project calls corrected to `view_kind`; `e2e_v11_run_over_binding_c` drives `hello → open_session{client} → project + account + head + describe + list_leases` end-to-end on the real kernel |
| `list_leases` is experimental-tier — the surface's hello never opted in, so V11's lease call refused `ExperimentalRequired` | `capabilities.experimental: true` declared at the surface's hello (opt-in is the declared mechanism; the op admission table stays closed) |
| stub kernels masked all three: the fixture answers canned results without strict-decoding | new coverage lands the real `EmbedService` behind `serve_net_n` for both the declaration (`net.rs`) and a session-bearing view (`e2e.rs`); the stub fixture stays for the gate/op-admission legs where the kernel is irrelevant |
